name: TeamPassword
description_en:
TeamPassword is a shared credential manager for agencies and other teams organizing logins by project, client or department. Groups define access to records, while web, extension and mobile clients provide different parts of the workflow.

It is useful to evaluate with a small set of shared test logins before importing an agency’s full client list. Membership changes and vault controls need to be paired with the external service’s password rotation and session controls.
description_zh:
TeamPassword 面向机构和其他团队，按项目、客户或部门组织共享凭据。通过分组控制记录访问，网页、扩展和移动客户端承担不同流程。

可先用少量共享测试登录评估，再导入机构全部客户资料。成员调整及保险库控制需配合外部服务的密码轮换和会话控制。

sections.title_en: A record can belong to multiple groups
sections.title_zh: 一条记录可属于多个组
sections.en:
Only Owners and Admins create groups. Both users and records may belong to multiple groups, so removing someone from one group does not by itself prove they have lost every route to a record. The help guide specifically requires saving membership changes before leaving the page. Deleting a group first requires moving or removing its shared logins.

For an example agency pilot, create Client A and Client B groups, place a disposable login in both and inspect access from a test member. Then remove that member’s paths and verify access again. This is a proposed permission test, not a claim that it was executed.
sections.zh:
只有 Owner 和 Admin 可创建组。用户和记录都可属于多个组，因此从一个组移除成员并不能证明已撤销其访问同一记录的全部路径。帮助指南特别要求离开页面前保存成员更改，删除组前须先移走或删除其中共享登录。

机构试点可建 Client A、Client B 两组，将测试登录放入两组，并核对测试成员访问；再移除其各条路径并重新验证。这是建议权限测试，并非实际执行记录。

sections.title_en: Import and recovery have distinct constraints
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ documents CSV import and an example template. Any member can import, but only administrators can create new groups during import. It also says support cannot reset a forgotten master password or recover its data. Two-factor backup codes bypass the second factor; they do not replace the master password.

The mobile guide permits viewing and adding logins but directs imports, exports, master-password changes, SSO configuration and team administration to the browser. A phone-only rollout therefore cannot be assumed to cover administration. Google Sign-In requires a Google address matching the TeamPassword address.
sections.zh:
价格 FAQ 说明 CSV 导入和模板，成员都能导入，但导入期间仅管理员可新建组；同时说明支持不能重置遗忘的主密码或恢复其数据。两步验证备用码用于绕过第二因素，不能替代主密码。

移动指南允许查看和新增登录，但导入、导出、主密码更改、SSO 配置及团队管理需通过浏览器。不能假定仅用手机即可完成管理。Google Sign-In 要求 Google 地址与 TeamPassword 地址一致。

sections.title_zh: 最低席位及企业专属控制
sections.en:
The page displays Standard rates of USD 2.88 and 2.41 per user/month and Enterprise rates of USD 6.30 and 5.25, with monthly/annual controls and a three-user minimum. Static text does not reliably label each displayed value’s selected billing state; confirm the term and total at checkout. Switching an existing subscription from monthly to yearly immediately charges the stored card, according to the FAQ.

Standard lists unlimited records and groups, TOTP and 10 MB attachments. Enterprise adds One-Time Secret, a view-only role, enterprise SSO and 250 MB attachment storage. A homepage mention of a capability does not establish Standard entitlement. No self-hosting or open-source license was verified.
sections.zh:
页面显示 Standard 每用户每月 2.88 和 2.41 美元，Enterprise 为 6.30 和 5.25，并有月付／年付切换及三用户最低要求。静态文本未可靠标明每个显示值对应的账期，须核对结账周期和总额。FAQ 说明从月付改年付会立即向已存银行卡扣款。

Standard 列不限记录和组、TOTP 及 10 MB 附件；Enterprise 增加 One-Time Secret、只读角色、企业 SSO 和 250 MB 附件存储。首页提到某功能不代表 Standard 有权使用。未核自托管或开源许可。
